f3e1b8bd: ;
This routine runs on the VA FileMan Monitor file #10.3
for TERMS IN DELINQUENT CERTS SEC.

It performs the following functions for each term specified in the list:
   * Sets variables
   * Prints a header line
   * Calls DGJOTP4 to list the records within each division
   * Prints summary totals for each division
f2231a63: ;Initialize variables

23245010: ;For each term in the list, do:
    * SET init variables
    * HEAD1 print header line
    * LIST call DGJOTP4 to print list of recs
    * TOT print summary totals for division
9350646e: ;Quit the routine

2e886e92: ;Initialize counters for this term
DGJTDIC = days discharged to documented
DGJTTRN = days documented to transmitted
DGJTCOD = days transmitted to coded
DGJTTODY = total days delinquent
DGJTO30 = days delinquent more than 30 days
DGJTOREC = total records
e1bcd791: ;Print division summary column titles

9ecc3b49: ;Print division summary statistics
All averages are divided by total records processed for this division

3e56d4c5: ;Continue until end of term list

DGJTOT is a local array containing the summary statistics indexed by term number:
    $P(DGJTOT(term),'`',1) = total records processed
    $P(DGJTOT(term),'`',2) = records delinquent >30 days

RET1 is an entry point called to handle screen full condition when printing the list of records. It must preserve DGFX, which is an index into DGPTF, an array containing the record data.
027d92d2: ;Quit summary statistic section

1de5a707: ;Print header for division totals
DGJTDAT is the current date
d010be92: ;Print column titles for statistics

f6f3d6ff: ;DGJTLN = underlines to follow column titles
Print underlines
8bc283da: Clear screen if printing to terminal and allowed to scroll
41457691: Exit if output device is not a terminal
802242c2: Prompt user to continue or quit, and set flags accordingly
59ab5f1e: If enough lines left on page, print header or subheader as needed, quit if user requested
0d45a1e6: Quit routine
4353be27: Reset page counter if division changed
a385204a: Print report header with date, title, and page number
bfff25c9: Print column headers if sorting by service/specialty
e034218c: Print column headers if sorting by physician
abe06308: Print 'LOCATION' column header
f3c9f4b4: Print 'PHYSICIAN' column header if sorting by service/specialty
d6aa532d: Print 'TYP' and 'STATUS' column headers if printing transcriptions
120e8641: Print remaining column headers
c984db28: Exit header print routine
b12be72b: Check if any data to print, quit if not
8f1d0550: Print data count and totals, scroll if needed
98464141: Display the count of patients seen for the selected division, service, procedure, and provider type.
6c96f274: If no procedures exist for the selected division, service, and provider type, quit.
770f6f7a: Display the service subtotal count, and print the return character if output device is not a terminal.
8f8a6f69: Quit the routine.
db7aac47: Loop through physicians or services and display data for each.
d646a6bb: Quit the routine.
983d6d0c: Display provider name and percentage of encounters for each encounter type (inpatient, outpatient, emergency room, etc.).
e0c53538: Display percentage of encounters for additional encounter types.
9a12ebb2: Display total encounter count, relative value units, and percentage of relative value units.
dd75d13f: Quit the routine.
d676e8fe: If $X is null or empty, set X to 0. Otherwise, keep the original value of $X.
009c8039: If $X contains a decimal point, extract the integer portion and keep only the first two digits after the decimal point. Right justify and write $X with a width of 7 characters.
04892baa: Right justify and write $X with a width of 7 characters.

1ed05d5c: Calculate the average days for the current division and type (physician or service) by summing the number of records, 0-7 day, 8-30 day, 31-365 day, and over 365 day counts, and dividing each by the total record count. Write the average values in columns starting at position 88.
782772c3: Write the average 0-7 day, 8-30 day, 31-365 day, and over 365 day values in separate columns, using the EXT subroutine to format the numbers.
f37d9f7b: End of subroutine.
bfdf04d6: Accumulate the division totals for record count, 0-7 day, 8-30 day, 31-365 day, and over 365 day counts.
d18b7f06: End of subroutine.
